product_one_liner.value: Hover turns smartphone photos of homes and other properties into accurate interactive 3D models with measurements, design visualization, and estimating tools for construction professionals, insurance experts, and homeowners.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage and About page describe product and audience.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Starter, Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: Names appear in Hover's customer stories.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies the headquarters as San Francisco, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: Hover blog states the company was founded in 2011.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index shows product, industry, and customer-facing content, not at least two engineering-authored articles about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public Help Center and developer documentation contain multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The reviewed current open roles include engineering and business positions, but no title matching the specified AI/ML/data-science terms.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product/help documentation, GenAI notice, privacy and trust center links; no named model or provider could be verified.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust-center page was identified, but its contents could not be retrieved to establish a positive claim or a sourced empty certification list.

last_funding.notes: Reported Series D was $60 million, announced November 17, 2020; funding trackers identify this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported funding was in November 2020, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Sales Development Representative (SDR) role is posted on Hover's careers site.

launched_6mo.notes: Hover announced a new connected visual platform on January 13, 2026, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently supported dated C-level or VP hire/departure was found, and the available team information was insufficient to establish that none occurred.
